taxonomy_note: Workflow routing only. Choose final root-cause taxonomy from supported evidence.

controls.boundary: Flux source reconciliation and impersonated deployment identity
controls.source_trace: Trace who can reference or alter a source and which identity applies its rendered resources. Distinguish controller identity from per-reconciliation impersonation.
controls.implementation_branch: Trace source artifact revision/digest into the Kustomization or HelmRelease and its effective serviceAccountName/controller identity. Source read access does not equal deployment edit authority. A namespace boundary can be crossed through allowed references only if the actual controller configuration and impersonated identity permit it; inspect cross-namespace-reference policy explicitly.
controls.controlled_verification: Use an isolated fixture with two owned namespaces and inert manifests; compare intended source/account with a forbidden cross-namespace reference.
controls.false_positive_discriminator: A source download alone is not privileged application; record the actual apply authority and admitted objects.
controls.remediation_acceptance: Bind source references and reconciliation identities to tenants, preserving valid dependency and rollout behavior.
